COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.
   C. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
